page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core scoring 86177.99 and PassMark CPU scoring 59279.8, both placing in the top 25% of tested hardware. The instance excels in parallel processing tasks, as evidenced by high scores in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and software compilation using Clang. Memory performance is highly efficient for small-block cached reads at 4142.89 GB/sec, though large-block uncached reads and writes fall into the average tier.

Given its balanced resource allocation and strong database operations benchmark of 22047.74 on PassMark, the ecs.g7a.16xlarge is well-suited for enterprise databases, high-throughput Redis deployments, and medium-scale LLM inference. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient choice for compute-heavy and memory-balanced workloads that utilize external storage, avoiding the premium associated with specialized hardware accelerators.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM, powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor at 2.55 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Lacking local storage and GPUs, it relies on network-attached storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The instance demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, scoring in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core performance, software compilation, and PassMark database operations. It also delivers high throughput for Redis SET operations, reaching 61.69 million operations per second. This balanced resource profile makes it highly suitable for enterprise databases, multi-threaded data processing, software development pipelines, and general-purpose containerized applications. It offers a cost-efficient, high-density CPU and memory configuration for workloads that do not require local NVMe drives or hardware acceleration.
